tactics:
induction xs generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih => cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n => simp only [List.drop_succ_cons] at h ⊢; rw [ih n j h]; simp [Nat.succ_add]

induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih => cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_drop, Nat.succ_add]
have h2 : (List.drop i xs)[j]? = xs[i + j]? := List.getElem?_drop
